description: Permanently delete multiple recent messages in one call. IRREVERSIBLE. SAFE BY DEFAULT: dry_run is true unless explicitly set to false, so call it first to preview, then re-call with dry_run:false to actually delete. Discord only allows bulk-deleting messages younger than 14 days; older ones are skipped. Requires the Manage Messages permission. Returns the number deleted.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel or thread to delete messages from.

count.description: Number of recent messages to delete (2–100).

dry_run.description: If true (default), only reports how many would be deleted without deleting. Set false to actually delete.

name: discord_bulk_delete_messages
